title: An unknown target is a load diagnostic
teaches: A :target that names nothing in the merged host-and-declared join is a diagnostic, not a crash. Pack exits 1 with the pacer code unknown_target (0), a byte span and the name in the message.
observe: pack exits 1 and prints a complete JSON envelope with pack: null.
The diagnostic source is pacer and the code is unknown_target.
The text loader reports the same diagnostic.
No carrier exists, so there are no frames.
